profile.headline: Software Developer at CCC Information Services
profile.summary:
4.5+ years of experience in analysis, design and development of client/server, web based application.
•	Certification in the “JAVA PROGRAMMING”, awarded by Information Technology Center, New Vallabh Vidya Nagar.     2010
•	Completed “Dynamic Load Balancing in Distributed Systems” using JAVA RMI (Remote Method Invocation) concept.     2010
•	Completed “Hostel Management Systems” in Visual Basic 6.0.     2008

positions.title: Associate Developer
positions.description:
• Developed 'Dealers' Featured Reviews Tool' on Cars.com so that Cars.com visitors can find the best dealers near from them.
Environment/Technologies: Java/J2EE, RestFul Webservices, JavaScript, JSON

•	Developed ‘Research Module Dropdowns’ on the Cars.com homepage using JavaScript Framework, CanJs so that contents (Make/Model/Year) in DropDowns are engaged quickly to the Cars.com visitors.
Environment/Technologies: JavaScript, JSON, CanJS.

positions.title: Java/J2EE Developer Intern
positions.description:
•	Participated in Agile Training and attending daily SCRUM meetings.
•	Worked in a cross-functional environment with Product Owner, Scrum Master, Mentors, and Architecture.
•	Developed cars.com Social Compare Tool (Spring MVC web application) that helps shoppers 
to get feedback/recommendation from Face book(Family/Friends) to make purchase decision easier in cars shopping process.

Environment/Technologies: IBM Web Sphere Portal 6.5, Core Java, Spring MVC, JSP/Java Servlet/Java Bean, RESTful web services, XML, HTML, CSS, Face book Social plug-ins.

positions.title: WebDevelper Intern
positions.description:
Worked as a Website Refresh Intern for Local First Chicago to maintain their website using web content management system. 
•	Reviewed website of Local First Chicago to identify defects in it and then repaired it.
•	Recommended a streamlined sitemap and formatting standards.
•	Researched and created a directory of all business services available in the Chicago area. 
•	Used web content management application with web development programming language (HTML, JavaScript) knowledge for Local First Chicago website to implement the new sitemap, update all pages to the formatting standards and then create an on-line version of the directory.
